speaker: A
word: Do you think AI will change our jobs a lot?
translation: Você acha que a IA vai mudar muito o nosso trabalho?
pronunciation: /duː juː θɪŋk ˌeɪˈaɪ wɪl tʃeɪndʒ ˈaʊər dʒɑːbz ə lɑːt/
portuguesePhonetic: [dú iú fínk ÊI-ÁI uíl tchêindj ÁU-âr djóbz a lót]

speaker: B
word: I think so, especially the repetitive tasks.
translation: Acho que sim, principalmente as tarefas repetitivas.
pronunciation: /aɪ θɪŋk soʊ ɪˈspɛʃəli ðə rɪˈpɛtətɪv tæsks/
portuguesePhonetic: [ái fínk sôu, is-PÉ-shâ-li dâ ri-PÉ-tâ-tiv tésks]

speaker: A
word: I’d like to spend less time writing reports.
translation: Eu queria gastar menos tempo fazendo relatórios.
pronunciation: /aɪd laɪk tuː spɛnd lɛs taɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ rɪˈpɔːrts/
portuguesePhonetic: [áid láik tú spénd lés táim RAI-tin ri-PÓRTS]

speaker: B
word: Me too. We’d have more time to investigate problems.
translation: Eu também. Teríamos mais tempo para investigar os problemas.
pronunciation: /miː tuː wiːd hæv mɔːr taɪm tuː ɪnˈvɛstɪɡeɪt ˈprɑːbləmz/
portuguesePhonetic: [mí tú. uíd rév mór táim tú in-VÉS-ti-guêit PRÓ-blâmz]

speaker: A
word: I’m going to start learning about it and try out a few ideas in my lab.
translation: Vou começar a estudar isso e testar algumas ideias no meu laboratório.
pronunciation: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː stɑːrt ˈlɜːrnɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt ænd traɪ aʊt ə fjuː aɪˈdiːəz ɪn maɪ læb/
portuguesePhonetic: [áim GÔU-in tú stárt LÂR-nin a-báut ít énd trái áut a fiú ai-DI-âz in mái léb]
